title: Verified Supply Contract
branch_scope: phase-5/prep — additive only; no activation; no merge to main until Phases 0–4 fossils exist
purpose: Establish that an offer is backed by real, deliverable supply before it can become sellable inventory. A generated idea is not inventory. Supply verification alone does not authorise checkout.
reconciles_with: economic-event schema (downstream; does not replace it)
non_goals: Does not create orders or record settlements
Does not replace the Canonical Economic Event Contract
Does not authorise checkout or public revenue claims
Does not invent competing evidence systems

rules: Supply verification is a necessary gate before sellable inventory.
Supply verification alone does not authorise checkout.
Gauntlet and activation remain separate subsequent gates.
Checkout may only be enabled after activation_approved for that offer on that silo.

required_supply_evidence.description: Every physical or digital offer that may become sellable inventory must carry a supply atom with all of the following.

supply_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this supply atom.

canonical_sku.description: Must match dreamledger/commerce-sku-contract/v1 allowed key resolution when the offer is sold.

silo_slug.description: Owning silo. Cross-silo supply claims are rejected.

source_refs.description: Independent references that support existence and deliverability (URLs, document IDs, inventory system keys, rights filings). Empty array fails.

ownership_or_rights_basis.description: Who may sell or deliver this: owned stock, licensed digital rights, self-produced digital good, or other explicit basis. Vague or missing basis fails.

available.description: For finite_units or delivery_capacity: non-negative remaining. Zero or exhausted is not sellable.

fulfillment_method.description: How delivery occurs (digital_delivery, physical_ship, human_service, automated_report). Must be consistent with the fulfillment registry.

price_source.description: Where the live Stripe (or other) price is defined. Missing price source blocks sellable status.

verification_status.description: Only VERIFIED may proceed toward Gauntlet/activation for sellable inventory.

expires_at.description: If set, past expiry forces STALE and HOLD.

fail_closed_rules.condition: No supply atom or required field missing
source_refs empty, unreachable, or do not support the claim
expires_at in the past or verification older than policy window without re-check
Evidence conflicts (quantity vs source, rights vs listing, cross-silo claim)
Same physical/digital units claimed by two live supply atoms without explicit split
Catalogue field published or inventory_count without a VERIFIED supply atom
fail_closed_rules.note: published + count alone never satisfies this contract

quarantine_when: fulfillment_method requires human delivery and no capacity evidence
pass_toward_activation_requires: quantity_or_capacity allows at least one delivery

required_tests.input: two live atoms claiming same units
source_ref that does not support claim
catalogue published true, inventory_count > 0, no VERIFIED supply atom

clone_factory_rule.new_shell: Must start with empty catalogue and zero supply atoms.
clone_factory_rule.forbidden: Copying master inventory, supply atoms, or credentials into a clone.
clone_factory_rule.activation: New silo may only attach supply atoms that pass this contract for that silo_slug.

adoption.production: Not binding on main until reconciled, tested, and Phases 0–4 fossils exist.
